text: No, the due-diligence file from June 2025 is no longer valid. New evidence from November 2026 shows a detected tree-cover loss event in 2025, affecting 13.5 hectares (3.91% of the asset). This loss is corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data, which confirms forest cover in 98% of the affected area. The earlier due-diligence assessment did not detect this loss because it was based on data up to 2024. The latest observations extend to 2025.
